title: The Mitopure Challenge to Detect Levels of Urolithin A in Dried Blood Spots
official: Open-labelled Study to Validate Home-based Use of a Health and Wellness Kit (The Mitopure Challenge) to Detect Levels of Urolithin A in Dried Blood Spots After Intake of Mitopure (Proprietary Urolithin A)
summary: Open labelled, virtual home based study to assess the test repeatability and the failure/rejection rate of the samples collected at home by participants.
